title: Nightly QA self-learning loop — design
summary: Approved 4-increment plan: (1) /graph/delta?since= daemon endpoint (the change sensor), (2) per-repo test-command config alongside set_task_repo, (3) self-learn-qa skill (read delta → run suite → diff vs last night → file only REPRODUCIBLE failures as problem nodes → update test-plan note via supersede_note), (4) nightly trigger. Key choices: trigger lives in Claude's scheduler kicking loop_start, NOT a daemon cron (daemon stays mechanical, agents do judgment); a failure must reproduce on rerun before becoming a problem node (flake discipline — don't poison verdicts with noise); nightly runs file + propose fixes but do NOT auto-merge initially — merges wait for morning guidance review; test plan is a note node per repo, revised via supersede_note for auditability.
